tools.name: find_broll
tools.description: Find verified b-roll for one subject: real photos and footage of exactly it, scored by a vision check, with license and source, best first. Use for any person, company, product, app, place, event or concrete scene a video mentions; for a whole script use plan_broll. Charged from the prepaid balance

tools.name: plan_broll
tools.description: Read a whole script, pick every moment that needs a cutaway (named things first, then concrete scenes), and find verified shots for each. Returns each moment with the exact words it starts on (and its time when word timings are given). For one subject use find_broll. Each moment is charged like a fi

tools.name: broll_usage
tools.description: See the prepaid balance, this month's spend, whether auto top-up is on, and the prices. Free. Read it before a long plan_broll, or when a search says the balance is low.
